pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū kokanade pāsāde sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā sakyaputtiyā sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessanti seyyathāpi gihī kāmabhoginoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhū sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhū sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggaṇhantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.11: hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.12: netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.14.1: na sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggahessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk55:1.16: yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca sāmisena hatthena pānīyathālakaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
